214:     #[track_caller]
215:     fn merge_routers(
216:         &mut self,
217:         other_path_router: PathRouter<S, false>,
218:         other_fallback_router: PathRouter<S, true>,
219:         self_default_fallback: bool,
220:         other_default_fallback: bool,
221:     ) -> Result<bool, Cow<'static, str>> {
222:         let other_routes = other_path_router.routes;
223:         let other_node = other_path_router.node;
224: 
225:         for (id, endpoint) in other_routes {
226:             let path = other_node
227:                 .route_id_to_path
228:                 .get(&id)
229:                 .expect("no path for route id. This is a bug in axum. Please file an issue");
230: 
231:             match endpoint {
232:                 Endpoint::MethodRouter(mut method_router) => {
233:                     if let MethodEndpoint::BoxedHandler(handler) = method_router.get {
234:                         method_router.get = MethodEndpoint::BoxedHandler(BoxedIntoRoute(
235:                             handler.0.clone_box(),
236:                         ));
237:                     }
238:                     if let MethodEndpoint::BoxedHandler(handler) = method_router.head {
239:                         method_router.head = MethodEndpoint::BoxedHandler(BoxedIntoRoute(
240:                             handler.0.clone_box(),
241:                         ));
242:                     }
243:                     if let Fallback::BoxedHandler(handler) = method_router.fallback {
244:                         method_router.fallback = Fallback::BoxedHandler(BoxedIntoRoute(
245:                             handler.0.clone_box(),
246:                         ));
247:                     }
248: 
249:                     if let Some((route_id, Endpoint::MethodRouter(prev_method_router))) = self
250:                         .path_router
251:                         .node
252:                         .path_to_route_id
253:                         .get(&**path)
254:                         .and_then(|route_id| {
255:                             self.path_router
256:                                 .routes
257:                                 .get(route_id)
258:                                 .map(|svc| (*route_id, svc))
259:                         })
260:                     {
261:                         let service = Endpoint::MethodRouter(
262:                             prev_method_router
263:                                 .clone()
264:                                 .merge_for_path(Some(path.as_ref()), method_router),
265:                         );
266:                         self.path_router.routes.insert(route_id, service);
267:                     } else {
268:                         let id = self.path_router.next_route_id();
269:                         let mut node = Arc::try_unwrap(Arc::clone(&self.path_router.node))
270:                             .unwrap_or_else(|node| (*node).clone());
271:                         if let Err(err) = node.inner.insert(path.to_string(), id) {
272:                             return Err(format!("Invalid route {path:?}: {err}").into());
273:                         }
274:                         let shared_path: Arc<str> = path.to_string().into();
275:                         node.route_id_to_path.insert(id, shared_path.clone());
276:                         node.path_to_route_id.insert(shared_path, id);
277:                         self.path_router.node = Arc::new(node);
278:                         self.path_router
279:                             .routes
280:                             .insert(id, Endpoint::MethodRouter(method_router));
281:                     }
282:                 }
283:                 Endpoint::Route(route) => {
284:                     self.path_router.route_service(path, route)?;
285:                 }
286:             }
287:         }
288: 
289:         match (self_default_fallback, other_default_fallback) {
290:             (true, true) => {
291:                 self.fallback_router = other_fallback_router;
292:                 Ok(true)
293:             }
294:             (true, false) => {
295:                 self.fallback_router = other_fallback_router;
296:                 Ok(false)
297:             }
298:             (false, true) => Ok(false),
299:             (false, false) => {
300:                 panic!("Cannot merge two `Router`s that both have a fallback")
301:             }
302:         }
303:     }
